cards.title: A number as a ratio
cards.idea: A rational number is any number that can be written as p by q, where p and q are integers and q is not zero.

interaction.prompt: Tap the number that can be written as a ratio of two integers

cards.reveal: 7 can be written as 7 by 1, so it is rational. Every whole number is rational.

cards.title: Fractions are rational too
cards.idea: A fraction like 3 by 4 is already in p by q form, so it is a rational number.

interaction.prompt: Type 3 by 4 in the form p by q using the numbers 3 and 4

cards.reveal: 3 by 4 has p equal to 3 and q equal to 4. Since both are integers and 4 is not zero, it is rational.

cards.title: Negatives and zero
cards.idea: Negative numbers and zero are also rational, because they can still be written as a ratio of integers.

interaction.prompt: Tap every value below that is rational: minus 5, 0, one half

cards.reveal: Minus 5 is minus 5 by 1, 0 is 0 by 1, and one half is 1 by 2. All three are rational.

cards.title: Decimals that stay rational
cards.idea: A decimal is rational if it stops after some digits or repeats a pattern forever, because it can be turned back into p by q.

interaction.prompt: Tap the decimals that are rational: 0.5, 0.333 repeating, a non repeating endless decimal

cards.reveal: 0.5 equals 1 by 2 and 0.333 repeating equals 1 by 3, so both are rational. A never ending, never repeating decimal is not rational.

cards.title: The q is not zero rule
cards.idea: The denominator q must never be zero, because dividing by zero has no meaning.

interaction.prompt: Tap the form that is not allowed as a rational number

cards.reveal: 5 by 0 is not allowed, since q cannot be zero. Only ratios with a non zero denominator count.

workbook.prompt: Which of these is a rational number?
A rational number can be written as p by q, where p and q are integers and q is not ________.
Why is 0.333 repeating a rational number?
options: Because it repeats a pattern and equals 1 by 3
workbook.answer: Because it repeats a pattern and equals 1 by 3

boss.prompt: Which value is not a rational number?
The whole number 12 written in p by q form with denominator 1 is ________.
A student writes a decimal that goes on forever with no repeating pattern. This number is
options: rational, because it is a decimal
not rational, because it cannot be written as p by q
boss.answer: not rational, because it cannot be written as p by q
